displayPattern: Amber LED on a Bryant 80% two-stage variable-speed furnace (troubleshooting guide TG-GFB80-02). Short flashes are the first digit and long flashes are the second. Code 23 is 2 short and 3 long
meaning: Pressure switch did not open. The chart says to check for obstructed pressure tubing or a pressure switch stuck closed.
diySteps: Count 2 short flashes and 3 long flashes. Do not jumper the pressure switch
Technician: check the pressure tubing for an obstruction, then the switch if it is stuck closed
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. A switch that stays closed is a safety-circuit fault, not a filter job.
